name: Golgotha Trench-Legions
identity: Faceless millions in greatcoats and gas masks. Officers turn mediocre soldiers into a machine; artillery and objectives win the war.

rules.name: Chain of Command
rules.description: When an Officer activates it issues 1 Order (⟳) to a friendly unit within 12″ that has not activated: Take Aim! (+1 to Hit, cannot Move) · Forward! (may Shoot after its 2nd Move) · Dig In! (Cover and Braced) · Fire Mission! (an [INDIRECT FIRE] unit hits on 4+ against any enemy a Golgotha unit can see). Orders are priced on the Officers.

rules.name: Gamble — Danger-Close
rules.description: When an [INDIRECT FIRE] unit targets an enemy unit within 6″ of a friendly Golgotha unit, it re-rolls Hit rolls; each unmodified Hit roll of 1 inflicts 1 Fatal Wound on the friendly Golgotha unit closest to the target. (Risk: durability (friendly fire).)

detachments.name: Combined Arms Regiment
detachments.playstyle: The default: infantry hold, tanks and walkers punch.

rules.name: Born Soldiers
rules.description: Trooper units that issued no Order and received no Order this round get +1 to Hit with ranged weapons if they did not Move.

enhancements.name: Grand Strategist
enhancements.description: **Trench-Marshal** only. This Officer issues 2 Orders per round.

enhancements.name: Relic Lasgun
enhancements.description: **Trench-Marshal** only. The bearer's ranged weapon gets +1 Attack and +1 PEN.

stratagems.name: Volley Fire
stratagems.turn: A Trooper unit is selected to Shoot
stratagems.effect: Its rifles gain [HAILFIRE] at full range this activation.

stratagems.name: Armoured Fist
stratagems.turn: A unit disembarks from a Transport
stratagems.effect: It may Shoot this activation even after Rapid Disembark.

stratagems.name: Fix Bayonets
stratagems.effect: Its retaliation strike gets +1 to Wound.

detachments.name: Siege Artillery Front
detachments.playstyle: Static gunline: mortars, Quake-Cannons and spotters grind the enemy into the mud.

rules.name: Pre-Registered Fire
rules.description: [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons get +1 to Wound against units within 6″ of an objective. Fire Mission! may be issued at 24″.

enhancements.name: Master of Ordnance
enhancements.description: **Trench-Marshal** only. Fire Mission! applies to 2 artillery units, and they re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Creeping Barrage
stratagems.effect: Pick a 6″ zone. Enemy units ending a Move in it gain 1 Suppression token.

stratagems.name: Danger Close
stratagems.turn: An [INDIRECT FIRE] unit targets an enemy engaged with friendlies
stratagems.effect: Allowed; each natural 1 to hit hits the friendly unit instead.

stratagems.name: Counter-Battery
stratagems.effect: After it resolves, one friendly artillery unit may shoot it.

detachments.name: Grinder Brigade
detachments.playstyle: Horde: bodies on every objective, never give ground.

rules.name: Endless Waves
rules.description: Once per round, when a Trench-Trooper unit is destroyed, set up a new 10-model unit of Trench-Troopers wholly within 6″ of your board edge (it counts as having activated). Max 2 per battle.

enhancements.name: Iron Discipline
enhancements.description: **Field Commissar** only. Friendly Troopers within 6″ ignore Rattled.

enhancements.name: Banner of the Unbroken
enhancements.description: **Trench-Marshal** only. The attached unit counts double CTRL while it has 5+ models.

stratagems.name: Hold the Line
stratagems.turn: A Trooper unit on an objective is targeted
stratagems.effect: It cannot become Pinned this round.

stratagems.name: Over the Top
stratagems.effect: It may Charge after a Move this activation.

stratagems.name: Meat Shield
stratagems.turn: A friendly vehicle within 3″ of a Trooper unit is targeted
stratagems.effect: The shooter must target the Troopers instead if they are visible.
